About RFC Football Academy, Bangalore

RFC Football Academy is a residential football academy in Bangalore for boys and girls who want to build a real career in the game, without giving up on their education.

A Residential Football Academy in Bangalore Built Around Academics

Our residential academy sits on a green campus in Devanahalli, Bengaluru. It is a full-year programme where football training and quality education run side by side, so student-athletes can chase a professional career while staying on track at school. Players live on campus, train daily with UEFA-licensed coaches, and follow a structured plan for fitness, nutrition and personal development.

Boys Residential Football Programme

The boys residential programme is for players aged 10 to 22 who are serious about football. Training covers technical skills, tactical understanding, strength and conditioning, and match play. Gym and swimming sessions are part of the weekly schedule, and players get regular competitive exposure through domestic and international tournaments.

India's First Girls Residential Football Academy

RFC runs India's first residential football academy for girls. The year-long programme balances sport and education in a safe and secure campus, with international coaches and a personal development module that builds athletic progress, character and leadership.

Football Trials: Who Can Apply and How Selection Works

Admission to the residential programme is through football trials. Players pre-register online, then attend a trial and interview. Our international technical team and independent talent scouts assess each player's ability along with their tactical, physical and psychological attributes. Eligible players are informed within a week of the trial. Girls can apply through the girls trials page.

Affiliations and a Real Professional Pathway

RFC Football Academy is supported by the All India Football Federation (AIFF), the Karnataka State Football Association (KSFA) and the Bangalore District Football Association (BDFA). Our own club, Rebels FC, was founded in 2006 and plays in the Super Division, giving students a direct route into league football. RFC players have gone on to the Indian Super League and national youth teams, including Dinesh Singh (Odisha FC and the India U17 squad) and Pungte Lapung (Odisha FC).

Grassroots and Specialized Programmes in Bangalore

Not every young player is ready for a residential programme. Our grassroots programme gives children aged 6 to 12 an age-appropriate start through small-sided games and skill-focused sessions. Specialized programmes, including our 7-day and 21-day football bootcamps, help players sharpen specific skills over a short period.

Why Families Choose RFC as the Best Football Academy in Bangalore

Parents tell us they value three things: coaching that treats every player as an individual, an environment that builds discipline and independence, and regular communication about their child's progress. Our focus is simple. Real pathway, not hype.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is RFC Football Academy located?

Our residential academy is in Devanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka.

What age group can join the residential programme?

Boys aged 10 to 22 can apply through our football trials.

Do residential students continue their studies?

Yes. The programme integrates academics with football training through the full year.

How do I register for football trials?

Pre-register on our trials page. We will confirm your trial slot and share the results within a week of the trial.

Is RFC Football Academy affiliated with AIFF?

RFC Football Academy is supported by the AIFF, KSFA and BDFA.
